name: plamo-translate
description: Translate prompts before the model reads them and Claude's text and questions before you read them, with PLaMo 3 Translate on mlx-lm or llama.cpp

replyLanguage.title: Reply language
replyLanguage.description: Language Claude's text and questions are shown in (PLaMo code such as ja, en, zh-hans). off: show replies as written.

promptLanguage.title: Prompt language
promptLanguage.description: Language your prompts are translated into before the model reads them. off: send prompts as typed.

port.title: PLaMo server port
port.description: Local port of the mlx_lm.server or llama-server that serves PLaMo; started on demand when nothing listens there.
